videos.title: I Gave GrokBot My Resume and Let It Do the Work
videos.summary: Mike builds a GrokBot job search agent with the Treg plugin. It rewrites his resume for ATS checks and queues remote job emails for his approval.
videos.heading: I Gave GrokBot my Resume and let it do the Work

videos.title: Why Grok Bot Drains Your Credits So Fast (And How To Fix It)
videos.summary: See why GrokBot credits disappear so fast and the settings and prompts used to cut usage, from pausing routines to moving them into their own bot.
videos.heading: GrokBot credit usage: why it drains and how to save

videos.title: Herdr On Windows Is Better Than I Expected!
videos.summary: Explore Herdr on Windows: PowerShell installation, themes, a credit-usage mod and Insights. The recording also tours an Update Forge app build.
videos.heading: Herdr on Windows: Installation, Themes, Mods and Usage

videos.title: New HERDR Desktop App Is A Game Changer!
videos.summary: Set up Herdr Desktop, open coding-agent workspaces and try themes. The walkthrough resumes Claude Code and explores agent panes, with migration and access limits.
videos.heading: Herdr Desktop Setup: Workspaces, Themes and Claude Code

videos.title: 3 Open Source Projects I Built That You Need to Try!
videos.summary: Tour Tasky, Restic-Studio and Luma-Launcher: a task monitor, backup app and Linux launcher. See the project interfaces and the AI coding workflow behind them.
videos.heading: Tasky, Restic-Studio and Luma-Launcher: Project Demos

videos.title: I Built My Own Task Manager In Claude Code (It's Free!)
videos.summary: Tour a task manager built with Claude Code for Linux and Windows. Inspect process metrics, the prompting approach and a request for Debian and AppImage packages.
videos.heading: Claude Code Task-Manager Demo: Processes and Packaging

videos.heading: CleanYourTV and Claude Code: customize Android TV
